title: Owl Wing Thicket
wikitext:
[[Image:Owl Wing Thicket.jpg|thumb|Owl Wing Thicket]]

'''Owl Wing Thicket''' is a series of caves in southern [[Winterspring]].{{co|65|60|Winterspring}} They host a large number of berserk, moontouched, and crazed [[owlbeast]]s. It is here that the ancient Guardians of [[Elune]] tell how the [[moonkin]] came into the world (in a quest chain exclusive to the Alliance), guided by [[Ranshalla]].

Places to safely go [[AFK]]:
* On top of cave entrances.
* South of the southernmost cave on a cliff overlooking [[Frostwhisper Gorge]].
